title.es: Aquel del brindis que Marta rechazó
title.en: The One With the Toast Marta Refused

description.es: Marta entra en la cocina mientras Isidro, Digna y Fina comen y brindan con vino. Fina la invita a brindar con ellos, pero Marta declina la inviación diciendo que tiene que ir a la fábrica. Cuando Isidro dice que están celebrando antes de que Fina se vaya, Marta se asusta, pensando que Fina se va a algún lugar lejano. Se tranquiliza cuando Fina dice que solo va a volver a la colonia. Tras marcharse Marta, Digna comenta que algo le pasa a la chica: no ha aceptado ni un brindis de cinco minutos.
description.en: As Isidro, Digna, and Fina are eating and toasting with wine in the kitchen, Marta comes in. Fina invites Marta to toast with them, but Marta declines, saying she has to go to the factory. When Isidro says they are celebrating before Fina leaves, Marta grows afraid, thinking Fina is going somewhere far away. She is relieved when Fina says she is only returning to the colony. After Marta leaves, Digna remarks that something is going on with that girl, she would not even accept a five-minute toast.
